result: Lean module FermionSignU1WilsonAction compiles under Lean 4.35.0 with pinned Mathlib (commit 56a005855ea17e0b0958f73ec801ae140b0a1679). The twelve printed declarations use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. fsp_u1_wilson_action states gauge invariance of the U(1) Wilson action on any finite family of closed oriented paths (for g: V -> Circle and for angle shifts) and nonnegativity for beta >= 0; wilsonAction_nonneg_needs_beta shows beta >= 0 cannot be dropped.
proof_boundary: Links are functions of ordered vertex pairs; on (ZMod L)^d with L <= 2 the parallel links between neighbours are identified. No fermion-sign consequence, non-abelian action, reflection positivity, transfer matrix or continuum limit is stated.
